title: ARCADE: THE HOST INITIALS CARD STAYS ON THE HOST
why: His yes to the five recommendations for the Halloween party mode, arcade27 (a low finding of the arcade 14-25 review). The initials card the host gets at a top 10 extraction was also sent to the player 2 window on its attract, and it took over that pad, so player 2 pressing A typed on the host card instead of dropping in. Now the card is shown to player 2 only at RUN OVER, never during a live raid, and a card kept from the extraction is shown to player 2 when the run ends. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade the initials card from a top 10 extraction stays on the host window, so player 2 can still drop in with A, and player 2 sees the card only at RUN OVER.
